steps.note: Inspect. The records in scope are listed, and any skipped file is reported.
Partition. The records are cut into chunks, each read on its own.
Map. Each chunk is checked against this skill's rules, one chunk at a time.
Compute. Each measure is recomputed from its source and compared with last month.
Verify. Each cited line is re-read, and a finding that does not hold is dropped.
Report. Status: draft for the owner to review. It is not a decision.

outcome.verdict: 1 figure does not match its source

findings.title: Figure does not match its source
Change above 25 percent with no note
findings.fix: Explain the change in one line

example:
Illustrative example: the items and results are made up, not real output.
Summary: 3 findings (1 high, 1 medium, 1 low).
[high] hr-headcount.csv:12  Figure does not match its source.
       Fix: Recompute from the source.
[medium] summary.md:19  Change above 25 percent with no note.
       Fix: Explain the change in one line.
[low] hr-hires.csv:26  Month missing.
       Fix: Add the month.
Not checked: Business outcomes.
pros: Checks a figure that does not match its source, a missing month, and a change above 25 percent with no note.
input: The records for this review, as text or CSV
output: A draft report: findings with location, fix and a not-checked list
prompt: Use the rlm-hr-monthly-report skill on the records for this review.
